findings.desc: Active host/capability runtime still exports Authority receipt/server completion semantics after Authority Server retirement. packages/main/src/core/capabilities.ts:63-66 hard-codes authorityRules.productionDoneRequiresReceipt=true and receiptCapability="receipt-verify"; capabilities.ts:125-135 describes submitting signed evidence to an external authority service and verifying an authority receipt before production completion; capabilities.ts:338-350 keeps a Server profile with receipt verification available. packages/main/src/core/lattice-hosts.ts:354-357 tells users production completion still requires a verified authority receipt, and lattice-autopilot.ts:1828 records "authority receipt gate passed". Runtime confirmation: node --input-type=module import of buildCapabilityList() reports productionDoneRequiresReceipt=true and server.receiptVerify.status="available". This leaves an active CLI/runtime product model where Authority-style receipt verification is still the productionDone path, contradicting B-576e replacement semantics of local proof admissibility, signed/offline receipt bundles, and local review quorum.

Active docs still expose retired Authority/autopilot mode guidance: docs/guide.md:58 titles the current Autopilot section as `local / shadow / authority` even though line 69 says local is the only active mode, and docs/guide.md:127 says source-aligned redevelopment runs under either `local` or `authority`. This leaves residual Authority mode wording in active user-facing guidance instead of removing it or marking it legacy/out-of-core/superseded, so users can still infer an active authority path after this retirement story.

Quality blocker: npm run test:process-fact-contract fails after Authority Server retirement. The implementation removed authority_receipt_verify and artifact:authority-receipt-refs.json from packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts, but scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs still requires both at lines 131 and 169 and still requires the old decision-doc Authority boundary tokens at lines 2663-2664. The current decision_doc_save authorityBoundary wording at packages/main/src/handlers/decision-doc-promotion.ts:507 no longer satisfies that contract, so the repo root process-fact contract test fails. Synchronize the verifier with the retired Authority semantics or restore an equivalent registered fact if it remains gate-consumed before this can pass REVIEW.
